m0-context.title: Load baseline context + verify handoff complete + finish audit
m0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the g2 handoff, and the G1 review-result probe. Verify handoff completeness (task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop/return). Complete the producer/consumer convention audit (g-unit vs m/s2 paths, ceiling units, friction/apex/fallbacks, double-correction). If incomplete or a hard stop-condition triggers, block and return. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff + G1 probe loaded; handoff complete; convention audit resolved (g-unit producer is single convention; ceiling resolved to m/s2; friction/apex/fallbacks understood)
postconditions.satisfied_by: Crew context+glossary+handoff+G1 probe loaded. Handoff complete. Audit resolved: live #522 path = g-unit producer (store A0 1.6-5.0g); fix=xG drop rho; ceiling=m/s2; capability_envelope L82 headroom needs xG; friction/apex delegate (no double-correction); second convention-A path (LateralEnvelopeFit/FitStore) is runtime-disjoint, out of scope, tests re-baselineable.

constraints: do not touch store schema or regime_utilization comparison logic

m1-truth-anchor-red.title: Add truth-anchor test (RED: fails pre-fix)
m1-truth-anchor-red.imperative: Add a truth-anchored test asserting the Monaco/VER tunnel cap (kappa approx 0.011, g-unit A0 from the real producer ~3.2) yields ~63-66 m/s (NOT ~16), i.e. lateral capability ~3-5g. Place it where the data-model / sim cap is exercised (test_physics_data_models.py and/or test_physics_simulator.py). Confirm it FAILS pre-fix (g-unit A0 read as m/s2 gives ~16 m/s / ~0.3g).

postconditions.statement: new truth-anchor test exists and FAILS on the pre-fix code (red observed)
postconditions.satisfied_by: RED observed: pre-fix lateral_capability=0.57g (absurd), tunnel cap=22.5 m/s. 2 truth-anchor tests added in TestLateralCapabilityTruthAnchor.

constraints: test asserts PHYSICAL truth (3-5g lateral / ~63-66 m/s tunnel cap), not a mechanical x9.81 of an old value

m2-data-model-fix.title: Fix LateralParameters.lateral_capability (xG, drop rho) + canonical G constant
m2-data-model-fix.imperative: In physics_data_models.py add a single named gravity constant (reuse/centralize; do not scatter 9.81). Change lateral_capability so mechanical = A0*tire_factor*g_track*G and aero = A2*speed**2*G (drop spurious rho, add xG). Ceiling stays m/s2 (now unit-consistent with mechanical+aero). Update the g-unit docstrings.

postconditions.statement: lateral_capability applies xG and drops rho via the named G constant; truth-anchor portion exercising the data model now passes
postconditions.satisfied_by: Added canonical G_MS2 to physics_data_models; lateral_capability now mechanical=A0*tire*g_track*G_MS2, aero=A2*v^2*G_MS2 (dropped spurious rho). g-unit docstrings added. Truth-anchor data-model tests pass (3-5g, cap ~63m/s).

m3-simulator-fix.title: Fix _compute_speed_caps and _gsat_ceiling inline lateral scaling
m3-simulator-fix.imperative: In physics_simulator.py apply the same convention to _compute_speed_caps (A0 term xG; denom = curvature - A2*G not A2*air_density) and _gsat_ceiling (car_lat = (A0*g_track + A2*v_ref**2)*G). Prefer reusing the canonical G constant / the data-model helper; if full de-dup is too large, use the single named constant identically and note inline duplication as triage.

postconditions.statement: sim caps + gsat use xG and drop the spurious air_density on the aero/denom term; full truth-anchor test passes
postconditions.satisfied_by: _compute_speed_caps: A0 term *G_MS2, denom=curvature-A2*G_MS2 (dropped air_density). _gsat_ceiling: car_lat=(A0*g_track+A2*v_ref^2)*G_MS2, pop_max uses G_MS2. Imported G_MS2. Sim truth-anchor (tunnel cap physical 58-75 m/s) passes.

constraints: gsat pop_max clamp now meaningfully bites

m4-consumer-audit-fix.title: Fix capability_envelope headroom-check units; confirm friction/apex/fallbacks
m4-consumer-audit-fix.imperative: In capability_envelope.py fix the ceiling-trust headroom check (ceiling - A0*g_track) to (ceiling - A0*g_track*G) so it is m/s2-consistent post-fix. Confirm friction_coupling.py and apex_extract.py delegate to lateral_capability (no inline mis-scaling / no pre-existing compensation to undo) and that braking/traction grip-ratio fallbacks ride the corrected lateral as intended. Record findings.

postconditions.statement: headroom check unit-consistent; friction/apex/fallbacks audited with no double-correction; findings recorded
postconditions.satisfied_by: capability_envelope L84 headroom fixed to (ceiling - A0*g_track*G_MS2). friction_coupling+apex delegate (no inline scaling, util is dimensionless ratio). Fallbacks ride corrected lateral (intended). MC sampler convention-agnostic. No double-correction. Audit recorded in g2/audit-findings.md.

constraints: no double-correction; fix root not symptom

m5-rebaseline-tests.title: Re-baseline physics unit tests to physical g-unit truth
m5-rebaseline-tests.imperative: Re-baseline the lateral expectations across the g2 test files from convention-A m/s2 inputs (A0=30) to PHYSICAL g-unit inputs (A0~1.5-3.2, A2~5e-4) so lateral_capability lands ~3-5g, and update ceiling/headroom expectations to the corrected convention. Each new value must be physically justified (not a blind x9.81). Cover test_physics_data_models, test_capability_envelope, test_lateral_envelope ceiling tests, test_physics_simulator caps/gsat, and any apex/friction expectations.

postconditions.statement: re-baselined tests assert physical values and pass
postconditions.satisfied_by: Re-baselined 7 convention-A failures to physical g-unit inputs (A0~2.5-3.1, A2~3e-4): data-model lateral_capability_at_speed; 2 lateral_envelope ceiling tests; 4 capability_envelope (2 braking-ratio clamp, ceiling-trust, anisotropy). _params default A0 30->3.0. Each value physically justified (3-5g). All 124 g2 tests pass.

constraints: truth-anchored: physical justification per re-baselined value; do not blindly keep tests green

m6-verify-suite.title: Full g2 verification suite green
m6-verify-suite.imperative: Run the full g2 verification command; all targeted physics tests green including the truth anchor and re-baselined expectations.
